items.name: St Andrew's Parish Fair
items.description: A parish fair with rides, food stalls, games and activities and a singing competition. Entry is free for everyone.

items.name: Rhyme Time
items.description: A 30-minute session of stories, songs, actions and rhymes. You must have a child aged 1–5 years.

items.name: Family Tales
items.description: Stories, songs and rhymes for families. No booking needed.

items.name: Christmas Festival at Jack's Magazine
items.description: Stalls from local makers, live music and choirs, a visit from Santa, pony rides, puppet shows, wildlife encounters and heritage tours of a former 1870s explosives store. Tickets at the gate or on Humanitix.

items.name: Movies in the Park – SING
items.description: Free outdoor cinema with free popcorn and entertainment from 5pm. Bring a picnic rug or chairs. No booking needed. May be cancelled or rescheduled in poor weather.

items.name: JingleJam Christmas Event
items.description: A family Christmas show with live music, dancing and surprises. After the 9am and 11am shows there are outdoor lawn games, craft stations, a scavenger hunt, bubble and balloon animals.

items.name: Festive Fun Day 2026
items.venue: Clarke St car park (next to VicRoads)
items.description: Brimbank's Christmas celebration with Teeny Tiny Stevies, Damo Music for Kids, a visit from Santa, Farmer Darryl's animal farm, live butterflies, face painting, a festive trail scavenger hunt and a sensory lounge.

excluded.name: Williamstown Beer and Cider Festival (Sat 28 Nov, Seaworks)
excluded.reason: A licensed beer and cider festival for adults. Children can attend free but it is not a kids' event.
